note: Recipe for rebuilding agent/refdata: what fetch_refdata.py downloads. Paths are relative to agent/. refdata-downloads/ holds archives that build_refdata.py unpacks and checks member by member; it sits outside agent/refdata so that run clones never see it. agent/refdata/MANIFEST.json is a different file: the original 32-record manifest, kept byte-identical because every run clone contains it.

derived_from.note: Run-time capture of external artifacts (DATA-6, R6). Not version pinning: these identifiers record what was used, they do not freeze it.

changes: Added hgdp_1kgp_tarball, phase3_chr1..22 (+_tbi), chain_*, bref3. plink2 now records the Linux binary the published runs used (previous_record keeps the macOS one). jre url pinned to its version, with its 259 members. maps gains its 27 members. ancestry_vcf url moved to the S3 mirror that was hash-checked. Archives moved from refdata/tmp/ to refdata-downloads/. For every non-archive record the sha256 equals the working box's file; for archives the sha256 is from a full download on 2026-09-23 and each member equals the working box's file. Every url was hash-checked in full on 2026-09-23 except previous_url values. Evidence: SETUP.md section 8.

artifacts.note: url is the 1000 Genomes S3 mirror, hash-checked in full on 2026-09-23. previous_url (EBI) serves the same size but was not hash-checked (0.31 MB/s from the working box).
build_refdata.py writes yields from this: gunzip | bgzip -@ 4, then htslib's own .fai/.gzi. The uncompressed sequence's sha256 is 3a3872e7bdd1532fdbfbc3afd70c04ff8a12a109319ae050c91d962f32e16a4f.

PGS Catalog pgsc_calc HGDP+1kGP reference, published 2023-10-05. The tarball never existed on the working box, so retrieved_utc is unknown; its sha256 is from a full download at verified_utc, and its md5 equals the distributor's md5s.txt. Each listed member equals the working box's ancestry-ref/hgdp_1kgp/ file by sha256. About 16 GB over one connection: 6-8 h from the working box, 37 min with 16 ranged connections.

url pinned to the version the sha256 records (21.0.11+10); previous_url is a 'latest' alias that served 21.0.12.1 on 2026-09-23. The members are Contents/Home/*, which stage_refdata.sh copied to refdata/jre/; each equals the working box's file. It is the macOS aarch64 JRE the published runs had staged; it does not run on Linux, and no selection run starts Java.

The binary every published run used and the one agent/tools/ancestry.py calls. retrieved_utc is when the working box's bin/plink2 was written; the zip's sha256 is from a full download at verified_utc. previous_record is the original manifest's record: the macOS arm64 a.7.1 binary that built ancestry-ref/hgdp_basis on 2026-08-12, whose path put a zip URL at refdata/bin/plink2.
